name: A Steady Hand With Restless Things

description.value: Bonus to checks made to calm, contain, or negotiate with a freshly-bound soul, ghost-machine, or raging spirit before it decides you're a threat rather than a handler.

cinderfall.incomplete: No skill is named ('checks made to calm, contain, or negotiate') and no numeric value is given, and 'freshly-bound soul, ghost-machine, or raging spirit' has no matching engine-recognizable trait to predicate against -- nothing here to build a FlatModifier from without inventing both the skill and the target condition.
